fields.description: Automatic series for the announcement number.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: The headline, as it appears in a person's notification list. Plain text.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: How your society classifies this announcement — news, advisory, weather warning. Optional, and it changes nothing about delivery.
fields.label: Type

fields.description: How loudly this arrives. Routine waits in the list; important is marked out and offered email; urgent also stays at the top until read.
fields.label: Urgency

fields.description: Which part of the society is speaking. The announcement reaches this branch and everyone beneath it.
fields.label: From

fields.description: Who beneath that branch receives it: everyone, volunteers only, or members only. Somebody who is both receives one copy.
fields.label: Audience

fields.description: One line shown under the title in the list. Left empty, the list shows the opening of the body instead.
fields.label: Summary

fields.description: The announcement in full. Plain text.
fields.label: Body

fields.description: The wording on the button, if this announcement points somewhere.
fields.label: Link Label

fields.description: Where the announcement points, if anywhere. A path within the site, or an http, https, mailto or tel address.
fields.label: Link

fields.description: Draft is delivered to nobody. Published fans it out to everybody in the audience, and cannot be unsent.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Also send this as an email, on top of the notification list. Defaults on for important and urgent announcements.
fields.label: Also send as email

fields.description: When this was published. Set automatically when it goes out.
fields.label: Published On

fields.description: The day after which this stops appearing in people's lists. Empty means it does not expire.
fields.label: Expires On

fields.description: How many people this reached. Set automatically when it goes out.
fields.label: Delivered To
